name: Adeia Inc.
summary:
Adeia Inc. (ADEA) reported earnings of $0.34 per share on revenue of $96.12 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.30 per share on revenue of $96.08 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.33 per share. The company beat expectations by 3.03% while revenue grew 12.11% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect 2026 revenue of $395.0 million to $435.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $416.74 million for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Adeia invents, develops and licenses fundamental innovations that shape the way millions of people explore and experience entertainment in an increasingly connected world.
subject: Adeia Inc. Beat Expectations
